restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r2-prefix-v1 only (two partial rounds plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

Success probability 1 means: one deterministic procedure (centres c_i = i tried in the order i = 1, 2, 3, ... until the first collision) was executed once from the start on the fixed target and stopped with a collision after 2 trials; the time is the executed operation count of that run with every trial charged, failed ones included, and the memory the whole executable image (the static arena that serves every buffer included). It is not a probability over centres; no start was selected beforehand.

heuristics.statement: The counts of proof.md sections 6 and 7 describe the executed program of proof.md section 9 under the stated rules: 1 per field operation (a Montgomery conversion is one multiplication), 1 per element load or store plus 1 address operation, 3 per loop iteration plus 2 per loop exit (the loops written with the macro FOR8 are unrolled eight times in the source and charged 3 per pass of eight; the generated kernels are straight-line), 1 per other executed index or control operation (shift, mask, add, subtract, comparison, branch, assignment; the index and control code contains no integer multiplication, division or modulo: each is a shift, a mask, a running pointer, a counter, or the shift-and-subtract routine udivmod, charged as executed), the static-arena allocator charged load by load and comparison by comparison, the xorshift generator charged per shift, XOR and assignment, the report formatting, the single write and the exit charged in stage I with the stated constants, 258 per reduced permutation evaluation, and a register file of 18 words of 256 bits per transform block (16 data words plus two working words: the twiddle operand and the butterfly temporary) as the only register assumption.
heuristics.scope: All stages of the executed run of proof.md section 4 at the target dimensions (m = 390624 for the powering, N = 786432 and N' = 393216 in its transforms, 393217 evaluations of the line).
heuristics.extrapolation: None. The time is the executed total of one run of the shipped source, with every trial charged and the allocator, the report formatting, the single write and the exit charged in stage I; the only bounds in it are the stated per-byte, per-stage and system-call constants of proof.md section 4.2, each charged in full.
heuristics.limitations: The counts are produced by the instrumentation written into the source; the source is part of the proof text and was not run by the organizer. Word-level costs outside the stated rules (cache, bandwidth) are not part of the model.
